security_audit.summary: Static findings for backtick execution and reconnaissance are false positives caused by Markdown formatting and SQL examples. The skill has one real semantic risk: an example system RLS policy grants unrestricted access without role scoping.

remediation.issue: The system RLS policy uses FOR ALL USING (true) WITH CHECK (true) without role scoping.
remediation.suggestion: Scope system policies to service_role or a dedicated database role, or use audited SECURITY DEFINER functions for system actions.

semantic_findings.title: Overly Permissive RLS Policy Example
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md recommends a system RLS policy with FOR ALL USING (true) WITH CHECK (true). Without role scoping, generated migrations can bypass workspace isolation when database grants permit access.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The unsafe policy is explicit in the main migration example. Exact exploitability depends on Supabase grants, but the guidance can generate unsafe RLS behavior.

content.value_statement: Database migrations can break tenant isolation when schema changes and RLS policies drift. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a repeatable Supabase migration workflow.
actual_capabilities: Checks schema references and existing migration folders before proposing changes.
Structures Supabase migration files with timestamped names and clear locations.
Provides idempotent SQL patterns for tables, indexes, functions, triggers, and enum types.
Defines workspace isolation patterns using user_organizations and workspaces joins.
Supplies a pre-apply checklist for RLS, constraints, comments, and syntax testing.
limitations: It does not apply migrations automatically.
It assumes a Supabase and PostgreSQL project structure.
It does not inspect live database state unless the agent has project access.
Its sample system RLS policy needs role scoping before production use.

use_cases.title: Add Tenant Tables
use_cases.description: Create a migration plan for a new workspace-scoped table with indexes, constraints, and RLS policy notes.

use_cases.title: Standardize Migration Reviews
use_cases.description: Use the checklist to review migration files for idempotency, workspace isolation, and documentation gaps.

use_cases.title: Audit RLS Changes
use_cases.description: Check whether proposed policies follow the user_organizations and workspaces join pattern before release.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple schema change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this database migration skill to plan a Supabase migration for [table or change]. Include the filename, required checks, and review checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Add Workspace Isolation
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a tenant-scoped table.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a migration outline for [feature] that includes workspace isolation, indexes, constraints, comments, and RLS policy guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Existing Migration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request before applying a migration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this migration for idempotency, RLS coverage, workspace isolation, foreign keys, and operational risks. Return prioritized fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Step Schema Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced rollout across related tables and functions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a safe Supabase migration sequence for [schema change]. Include dependencies, rollback considerations, RLS review points, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: Add a tenant-scoped agent registry table.
output: A table, index, and constraint plan.
Workspace isolation and RLS policy notes.
A checklist for review before applying the migration.

output_examples.input: Review a migration that adds policies to a workspace table.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies missing workspace indexes, unsafe broad policies, and required validation steps before dashboard execution.

output_examples.input: Create an enum and trigger migration plan.
output_examples.output: The skill outlines idempotent enum handling, trigger replacement steps, comments, and syntax testing reminders.

best_practices: Check existing schema references and migrations before creating a new file.
Use idempotent statements so repeated execution does not fail.
Review every RLS policy against workspace isolation requirements before applying it.
anti_patterns: Creating tenant tables without a workspace_id column or index.
Adding broad system policies without scoping them to a trusted role.
Applying migrations before checking syntax, constraints, and existing objects.

faq.question: What projects is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for Supabase projects that use PostgreSQL, RLS policies, and workspace-based tenant isolation.

faq.question: Does it run database migrations?
faq.answer: No. It guides planning, writing, and reviewing migrations. A user still applies the SQL through approved tooling.

faq.question: Can it inspect my live database?
faq.answer: Only if the active agent already has authorized access. The skill itself does not provide database connectivity.

faq.question: How does it handle RLS?
faq.answer: It recommends workspace-based policies using user_organizations and workspaces joins, with extra review for system access.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What should I review before production use?
faq.answer: Review role scoping, service-role access, workspace indexes, constraints, and whether every table has appropriate RLS.
